6300: Sit with knees bent and lean back a little.
Lift your feet so your shins are parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest open and spine long.
6301: Stand and bend your knees slightly.
Cross one thigh over the other, hooking the foot behind the calf if you can.
Wrap your arms, one under the other, palms together.
Sit your hips low and lift your elbows.
6302: Start in a headstand or lie on your back with elbows on the floor.
Arch your back and bring your feet toward the floor.
Stay in the backbend, breathing steadily.
Hold briefly, then come out carefully.
6303: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Lean back and reach for your heels.
Lift your chest and let your head drop gently if comfortable.
6304: Stand tall and bend one knee, holding that foot behind you.
Kick your foot back into your hand.
Tilt your torso forward as the leg lifts.
6316: Lift one leg back with a bent knee, sole toward the ceiling.
Lower it, then kick it across behind your other leg.
Keep your hips level, then switch legs.
6318: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower your hips.
Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes.
Push up and return, then switch sides.
6327: Step one foot forward into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright and your hands on your hips.
Lower your back knee toward the floor as far as you can control.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
6328: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
Lower your back knee toward the floor in a controlled way.
Push through your front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
6329: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step into a long split stance.
Brace your core and keep your torso tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor under control.
Press through your front foot to stand up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
6335: Start in a high plank, then rotate onto one hand with your chest turned to the side.
Lift your hips and keep your core tight.
Sweep your top leg under your body and through the gap.
Return the leg to the start with control.
6336: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat over about three seconds.
Pause briefly at the bottom with your chest up.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.
6341: Step into a wide lunge with the front knee bent.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Fold your torso inside your front thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
6344: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down into a squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then stand up.
6350: Lie face down with your arms stretched overhead in a Y shape.
Keep your forehead near the floor and your neck long.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower your arms slowly and repeat.
6354: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Place your feet on the footplates, shoulder-width apart.
Push the plates away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees at the top.
Bend your knees to return slowly and repeat.
6355: Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles at chest height.
Keep your shoulders down and back.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Let the handles come back slowly and repeat.
6356: Sit down and grab the handles overhead.
Lean back very slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the bottom.
Let your arms rise slowly until fully stretched, then repeat.
6358: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still and close to your body.
Curl your wrists upward, lifting the bar a short distance.
Lower the bar slowly and repeat.
6359: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your arms still at your sides.
Curl your wrists up, bringing the dumbbells toward your forearms.
6360: Face a low cable pulley and grab the handle with an underhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows tucked.
Curl your wrists upward against the cable.
6361: Stand holding an EZ bar with an overhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still at your sides.
Extend your wrists to raise the bar upward.
6362: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
Lift the backs of your hands up by extending your wrists.
6363: Face a low cable and grab the handle with an overhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows close to your sides.
Extend your wrists to pull the handle upward.
6364: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, holding an EZ bar overhand.
Let your wrists hang past your knees.
Extend your wrists to lift the bar.
6365: Stand holding an EZ bar behind your back with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows still and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to raise the bar slightly.
6366: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand behind your back, palms facing back.
Keep your arms still and your chest tall.
6367: Stand with your back to a low cable and hold the handle behind you.
Keep your elbows tucked and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to pull the handle upward.
6392: Sit at the pulldown station and grab the grip overhead.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the grip down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly to a full stretch and repeat.
